All 1389 tests pass, including the new `ForwardRef` cases for `_is_class_var`. The earlier failures were caused by pytest picking up a globally-installed `attrs` package instead of this repo's `src` — unrelated to the change.

## Summary

Fixed `_is_class_var` in `src/attr/_make.py` to detect `ClassVar` annotations that come back as unresolved `ForwardRef` objects (as happens on Python 3.14+ via `annotationlib.get_annotations(..., format=Format.FORWARDREF)` when an annotation can't be evaluated). `str()` on a `ForwardRef` produces `"ForwardRef('ClassVar[int]')"`, which never matched the expected prefixes — now the function unwraps `__forward_arg__` first to recover the original source text before checking.

- `src/attr/_make.py` — unwrap `__forward_arg__` before the prefix check
- `tests/test_annotations.py` — added `ForwardRef` cases to `test_is_class_var`
- `changelog.d/1593.change.md` — changelog fragment
